eventScripts.script:
logger = system.util.getLogger("AlarmTest")
	
	parsedJson = currentValue.value
	
	tagPaths = []
	tagValues = []
	
	for i in range(min(len(parsedJson), 10)):
	
	    alarmData = parsedJson[i]
	
	    alarmGroupID = alarmData["AlarmGroupID"]
	    alarmCode = alarmData["AlarmCode"]
	    FBS_Source = alarmData["FBSSource"]
	    active = alarmData["Active"]
	
	    # Default values
	    operatorMsg = ""
	    label = ""
	    troubleshoot = ""
	
	    # Only lookup valid alarm entries
	    if alarmGroupID != 0 and alarmCode != 0 and FBS_Source != "":
	
	        alarm = AlarmConfig.AlarmMessages_1.getAlarm(
	            alarmGroupID,
	            alarmCode,
	            FBS_Source
	        )
	
	        if alarm:
	
	            # Alarm found
	            operatorMsg = alarm["OperatorMessage"]
	            label = alarm["Label"]
	            troubleshoot = alarm["Troubleshoot"]
	
	            logger.info(
	                "Alarm found: Group={}, Code={}, FBSSource={}".format(
	                    alarmGroupID,
	                    alarmCode,
	                    FBS_Source
	                )
	            )
	
	        else:
	
	            # Alarm not found
	            operatorMsg = "Alarm need to add in lookup table"
	
	            logger.warn(
	                "Alarm NOT found: Group={}, Code={}, FBSSource={}".format(
	                    alarmGroupID,
	                    alarmCode,
	                    FBS_Source
	                )
	            )
	
	    # Prepare tags for writing
	    tagPaths.extend([
	        "[.]Operator_Msg_{}".format(i),
	        "[.]Label_{}".format(i),
	        "[.]Troubleshoot_{}".format(i),
	        "[.]Active_{}".format(i)
	    ])
	
	    tagValues.extend([
	        operatorMsg,
	        label,
	        troubleshoot,
	        active
	    ])
	
	
	# Write all values in one operation
	if tagPaths:
	    system.tag.writeBlocking(tagPaths, tagValues)

		logger.info("Alarm = {}".format(alarm))

		        [alarm["description"]]
		    )
		
		    logger.info("Write Result = {}".format(qv))
